title: Repair CI loopback URL construction and mask ephemeral test password
authorization: Bounded root-cause repair of the explicitly authorized public CI workflow after hosted run 30397064358; no product scope expansion.
root_cause: The workflow constructed a URL with new URL('postgresql:'), which Node treats as a non-authority URL: assigning hostname leaves it empty. The test-database guard correctly rejected it. The workflow also exposed the generated ephemeral password in GitHub's step environment log because it was exported without an Actions add-mask command.
forbidden: No Git/GitHub command, commit, push, Docker/local integration execution, database connection, deployment, or release.
No literal password, connection URL with host/credentials, secrets context, non-loopback target, or changed CI test lifecycle.
deliverables: .github/workflows/estateflow-ci.yml with authority-capable loopback URL construction and pre-export GitHub Actions mask command.
scripts/verify-ci-workflow.mjs enforcing the corrected URL base and masking contract while preserving unsafe-target rejection.
scripts/verify-ci-workflow.test.mjs with a negative missing-mask case plus existing negative safety cases.
Exact worker evidence at the declared absolute artifact path.
requirements: Construct the ephemeral URL with an authority-capable base new URL('postgresql://') before setting loopback host, port, database, user, and ephemeral password.
Generate the password in a shell variable, execute ::add-mask:: before exporting it to GITHUB_ENV, and export it without printing its value.
Update static verifier to permit a bare protocol base while still rejecting complete/literal unsafe database targets, credentials, and secrets context.
Verifier must require mask command and correct authority-capable URL construction; add a negative test that fails if mask command is absent.

red: node --test scripts/verify-ci-workflow.test.mjs before adding the required mask assertion; record the missing-mask failure.

acceptance: A minimal local Node proof demonstrates the URL has hostname 127.0.0.1 and the existing guard accepts the constructed safe URL without exposing a password.
CI workflow includes masking before GITHUB_ENV export, exact loopback/test target construction, and unconditional cleanup.
Verifier tests and verifier PASS; previous safety negative checks remain.
